esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; T6713 CO2 sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. Added a 4.7 kΩ resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x15. Added the t6713.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the CO2 level set on the slider: passes

pico.detail: 5 pins wired; T6713 CO2 sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. Added a 4.7 kΩ resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA GP4, SCL GP5) at address 0x15. Added the t6713.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the CO2 level set on the slider: passes
